coverage.comment: 24 distinct edition identities can share 6 described start areas (SZTL adult + youth differ; KZTL Jošt and Mohor share a venue) but zero league GPS coordinates are approved. They do NOT raise the runtime-approved denominator.

cautions: Venue descriptions from official 2026/27 organizer sources are not verified WGS84 pins and must never be converted to exact GPS without additional source proof.
Two SZTL start areas are tied to each edition (adult Mavrica, youth athletics stadium). Never silently represent all disciplines with one pin.
Jošt and Mohor share an explicitly described start but remain different races; edition identities are never collapsed.
2026/27 KZTL PDF has an introductory carry-over mention of 2025/26 although its title and competition table are 2026/27; use the actual 2026/27 table and source identity only.
Strava segments and linked tracks may guide human review but do not automatically prove an exact start-line coordinate or an edition-specific start.
Edition keys are year!Master_row and must be revalidated after Master changes; never bulk-approved.

venue_profiles.title: Savinjska zimska liga – odrasli
venue_profiles.note: Same season start for adults across nine remaining stages. Event page also includes a distinct children's start. Do not assume municipal centroid.

reconstruction_review.reconstruction_notes: 2025 road authority works at R2-447/0367 Žalec–Šempeter km 0.545–0.605; old pedestrian bridge demolished, new structure formally opened on 2 Feb 2026. The current-season organizer's 'Mavrica' start designation is valid venue text, but old pre-2025 bridge mapping/design render cannot be accepted as start geometry. Event could begin near an approach to the replacement bridge, rather than at the structure midpoint.

venue_profiles.title: Savinjska zimska liga – otroci
venue_profiles.note: Children run a distinct stadium course; never conflate with adult Mavrica reference point.

numeric_venue_candidate.name: Športni park Žalec / Športni center Žalec (complex, not athletics start)
numeric_venue_candidate.assessment: Mapped OSM recreation-ground/sports-centre polygon is the SPORT COMPLEX, not an identified athletics track or youth start line. Two cached views of the same source disagree by about 11 metres in longitude; do not choose one silently or increase approved coverage. Current 2026/27 organizer says children run on the athletics stadium. This is not the adult Mavrica start.

venue_profiles.description: Levi odcep poti, približno 100 m pred mostičkom čez potok, nad Mačami pri Preddvoru
venue_profiles.note: 10–15 minutes on foot from upper Mače parking. Organizer links a Strava segment, but no numeric start coordinate verified.

venue_profiles.title: KZTL – Sv. Jošt / Sv. Mohor
venue_profiles.description: Pod daljnovodi v vznožju Jošta pri orientacijski tabli, Kranj
venue_profiles.note: Same explicitly described start for two distinct routes (Jošt and Mohor), but distinct edition keys; cannot treat them as identical events or courses.

venue_profiles.title: KZTL – Krvavec
venue_profiles.note: Gondola lower station is officially designated start, not the hilltop finish; exact GPS of line unverified.
